We offer a very flexible return policy to ensure you are completely satisfied with your choice:

Trial Period:

You have 100 days to try our mattresses, bed bases, and sofa beds. We recommend sleeping on them for at least 30 nights to allow your body to adjust.
For bed linen and protections, the trial period is 30 days.
You also have a legal right of withdrawal of 14 days after delivery.

Free Returns:

All returns are 100% free of charge.
For large items like mattresses or beds, we will organize a collection directly from your home via a specialized carrier.
For smaller items like pillows or sheets, we will provide a prepaid Chronopost label for you to drop the package at a relay point.

Refund:

Once the item is received, you will be refunded on your original payment method, usually within 15 business days.

To initiate a return, simply send us a message via our contact form at https://hello.tediber.com/fr-FR/contact with a photo of the product.

Feel free to contact us anytime; we're here to help.
